Account closure is started from account settings after any open orders finish; you will be asked to confirm by email.
After several failed sign-ins the account locks for safety. Wait a short while, then use the password reset link to regain access.
Check spam and promotions folders first. If it is not there, share your order number and I will resend the confirmation.
Check the recycle or trash area first; recently deleted files can usually be restored from there for a limited time.
Delivery estimates are shown at checkout and in your confirmation message; they depend on your location and the items ordered.
During an outage, status updates are posted on the status page. Share what you are seeing and I will check the latest note.
Enter the code in the discount field before paying and check that the total updates. Codes cannot usually be added after payment.
Enter the gift card code on the balance page or at checkout to see the remaining amount.
Feedback can be sent through the feedback form or this chat; specific examples help the team act on it faster.
For bulk orders, share the product, quantity, and delivery location, and the team will reply with availability and pricing.
Gift messages are added at checkout and printed with the delivery note. Share your order number if the message needs changing.
If a payment failed, check that the card details and balance are correct, then try again. Share the order number if the charge still appears.
If your order has not shipped yet, I can update the delivery address. Share your order number and the new address.
If your order was cancelled, the confirmation message explains why and whether a refund is on its way.
Invoices are available from your orders page and are also emailed after payment. Tell me the order number if you need another copy.
Manuals are linked on each product page and in the support section; tell me the model name if you cannot find yours.
Once a returned item is received and checked, the refund goes back to the original payment method; the exact timing depends on your bank or payment provider.
Open account settings, edit the detail you want to change, and save. Some changes ask you to confirm by email first.
Open account settings, enter the new email address, and confirm through the verification message sent to it.
Open billing settings, add the new payment method, and set it as default before the next billing date.
Open subscription settings and choose pause if available; billing stops during the pause and resumes on the date shown.
Open the order in your account and choose download receipt; a copy is also attached to your confirmation email.
Open your subscription settings, choose cancel, and confirm. You keep access until the end of the current paid period.
Orders can be changed before they ship. Share your order number and the change you need as soon as possible.
Points are earned on eligible purchases and can be applied at checkout; your balance and expiry dates are shown in your account.
Restart the device, check your connection, and try the update again. Tell me the error message if it still fails.
Share your area or postcode and I will check whether the service is available there.
Share your order number and I will check its current status and tell you the next step.
Share your order number and preferred dates, and I will book the installation visit.
Share your order number, the fault, and your preferred pickup day, and I will book the collection.
Size exchanges are started from your orders page; the replacement is sent once the original item is on its way back.
Sorry about the duplicate charge. Share the order number and the charge dates, and I will check and arrange a refund of the extra charge.
Sorry the item arrived damaged. Share a photo of the damage and your order number, and I will arrange a replacement or refund.
Sorry the wrong order arrived. Share your order number and I will arrange a refund or the correct item for you.
Sorry you received the wrong item. Share your order number and a photo of what arrived, and I will arrange the correct item.
Sorry your delivery is late. Share your order number and I will check the latest carrier update right away.
Sorry your order is running late. Share your order number and I will track the package and tell you the latest delivery update.
Sorry your package has not arrived. Share your order number and delivery address so I can check the carrier record and arrange the next step.
Spare parts can be ordered from the parts section by model name; share your model if you need help finding the right part.
Start by charging or connecting the product as the guide shows, then follow the first-time setup prompts on screen.
Tell me the order number and the amount that looks wrong, and I will review the charge and correct it if needed.
Thanks for reporting it. Tell me the page address, what you expected, and what happened instead, and I will pass it to the team.
To request your data or ask for deletion, send a request from your registered email address so your identity can be verified.
To return an item, keep it unused with its packaging, start the return from your orders page, and follow the pickup or drop-off instructions shown there.
Use the forgot password link on the sign-in page; a reset link will be sent to your registered email address.
Use the tracking link from your confirmation message, or share your order number and I will look up the latest delivery update.
Verification usually means confirming your email address and, for some actions, entering a code sent to you.
Warranty cover depends on the product and the fault. Share the product name and purchase date and I will check what applies.
You can reach the team through this chat, the contact form, or the support email listed on the contact page.
